coverage_issues: Report 1 (qwen3-235b) failed to audit .gitignore due to API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError), resulting in an inconclusive verdict for the entire package
learnings: Tool errors (API failures, timeouts) on non-critical files like .gitignore should not force an 'inconclusive' verdict for the entire package when all security-relevant files (PKGBUILD, .SRCINFO, .install) are successfully audited and found safe
The audit tool should distinguish between 'file could not be analyzed due to tool error' and 'file contains suspicious content' when computing the overall verdict
Low-risk files (.gitignore, .nvchecker.toml) should be weighted appropriately in verdict calculation - failures on these files should not override successful audits of high-risk files (PKGBUILD)
